## Plug-In Bias

What's wrong with a plugin $\Psi(\hat{\p}_n)$? 

If $\hat{\p}_n$ is fit with ML we always get bias. 

Model selection: bigger and smaller models.

Validation error is bias^2 + variance. When we minimize it some bias (eg in $\mu$) remains and it translates to bias in $\hat\phi$

Bias is a problem if you want to construct CIs

The plug-in bias does not disappear quickly enough in the asymptotic expansion to be CLT-negligible 

Thus CIs etc will be wrong, even though estimate may be ok.
